notes: QE: the default is the multi-layer AR-coated e2v CCD QE (the inner 8 of 16 CCDs), which SVO's published g, r and i curves use; the single-layer QE (outer 8 CCDs) is variant 'single_layer'. Variant 'mean' (qe.dat) is a SED_Tools-derived equal-weight mean of the two, not a team product. No optics throughput is published.

sources.coatings: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZwickyTransientFacility/ztf_information/7c1d1ed1adeea47ee024272e797e77d7e65160d5/README.md: ZTF's 16 CCDs have two anti-reflection coatings: the northernmost and southernmost eight are single-layer, the inner eight multi-layer (ztf_information README).
sources.qe: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZwickyTransientFacility/ztf_information/7c1d1ed1adeea47ee024272e797e77d7e65160d5/QE/e2v_ztf_multi2.csv (e2v CCD QE, multi-layer AR coating (the inner 8 of ZTF's 16 CCDs); used by SVO's published Palomar/ZTF g, r and i)

mean.description: equal-weight mean of the single- and multi-layer QE, derived by SED_Tools (8+8 CCDs); no team document gives a camera-average QE

multi_layer.description: e2v CCD QE, multi-layer AR coating (the inner 8 of ZTF's 16 CCDs); used by SVO's published Palomar/ZTF g, r and i

single_layer.description: e2v CCD QE, single-layer AR coating (the northernmost and southernmost 8 CCDs)
